name: B1-NA blaster pistol
description: The B1-NA blaster pistol, also known as a Corpo blaster, was one of several types of blaster pistols used by Tac-Corpo troopers of the Pre-Mor Enforcement, Preox-Morlana's security branch. Although produced by BlasTech Industries, they had a Preox-Morlana corporate branding and serial number printed on them, and featured a detachable sight.
